round1_rejection_causes.cause: implementation_obligations.cases and unsourced NIP-0003 case scenarios
round1_rejection_causes.evidence: implementation_obligations has no cases key. Verification requirements for cases 7, 10, 11, and 12 say only that each command is the feature 130 acceptance command for its own case number and that the proposal does not claim the check already passes. The contract text contains no NIP-0003, handoff, fixture, or REPL narrative, and it does not say that a case number is the unsaved-definition, fasl, or deleted-definition case.
The key is absent from proposal_basis and from the rest of the contract.

observations: All twelve feature 130 acceptance commands are present exactly once as verification command strings and match .agent/feature_list_020.json feature 130 acceptance_tests. missing_acceptance_coverage is empty.

Saying that a command is the feature 130 acceptance command for its own case number is sourced by the feature list and the case matrix, which name cases 7, 10, 11, and 12 and their commands without a scenario.
The seven feature 129 acceptance commands in preservation.frozen_feature_129_acceptance_commands match feature 129 exactly and are not rewritten as feature 130 acceptance tests.

The contract denies that feature 130 checks already pass, limits product implementation to tools/runtime_session.py and tools/test_runtime_session.py, and its non-goals keep full-live and the seventeen-row/thirteen-case matrix on 131/132, forbid attempt 6, installed .nizam/ edits, an origin/main retarget, public schema or public API expansion, a budget increase, Source4 currentness-through-publication, and merging quarantine 5f7de0361cc7a9b255e80c9c8cca30fe05a4d11c.

Section 9 obligations remain on implementation_obligations and the named checks: git archive of committed source, fresh sbcl --no-sysinit --no-userinit --non-interactive, private HOME/XDG, empty private ASDF output cache, explicit configs containing :ignore-inherited-configuration, toolchain/lock/core provenance, and distinct ASDF no-op and genuine failure controls. Failure modes for unsaved definitions, a fasl compiled against an unsaved macro, inherited fasl or shared build cache, and a deleted definition that survives only in a development image remain on must_fail and are not mapped to case numbers. The Lisp forms are called illustrative, not a launcher. A fresh process is not a fresh build. Empty environment variables are not sufficient.

Budget figures 750, 650, 1200, and 2600, phase 7350, and ceiling 9555 match the feature list and the spec table. The contract records 1218 counted product lines, remaining headroom 632, and an excess of 118, and it says that the overrun is recorded at measurement and does not raise 7350 or 9555 and is not a free allowance, transfer, or rebaseline.
Status is proposed. validator_mode_a and evaluator_contract_review are false. approvals.revisions is 1. approved_at is absent.

verification also names bash tools/validate.sh and bash tools/validate.sh --payload once each, labeled as additional compliance rather than feature 130 acceptance tests. They do not duplicate or replace the twelve commands.
